proved.interpretation: All same-sign added eigenvalues are free regardless of rank/orientation/magnitude; all small opposite-sign eigenvalues cost one operator threshold h; all large opposite-sign eigenvalues cost only their projected H-footprint rank; arbitrary outside/cross curvature in T is free at this stage.
